March 4, 2018 - By whatsonthorold 
Whalerock Point Partners Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 3.75% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Whalerock Point Partners Llc bought 1,985 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 54,954 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $8.47 million, up from 52,969 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Whalerock Point Partners Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $894.09B market cap company. The stock increased 0.69% or $1.21 during the last trading session, reaching $176.21. About 38.45 million shares traded or 8.44% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since March 4, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
First Foundation Advisors decreased its stake in Netease Inc (NTES) by 79.21% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. First Foundation Advisors sold 10,265 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.53% while stock markets rallied. The hedge fund held 2,694 shares of the miscellaneous company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $711,000, down from 12,959 at the end of the previous reported quarter. First Foundation Advisors who had been investing in Netease Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $37.90 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.75% or $2.16 during the last trading session, reaching $288.71. About 1.46M shares traded or 9.40% up from the average. NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) has risen 77.85% since March 4, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 61.15% the S&P500. 
Among 19 analysts covering NetEase ( NASDAQ:NTES ), 12 have Buy rating, 4 Sell and 3 Hold. Therefore 63% are positive. NetEase had 43 analyst reports since August 12, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. On Friday, June 16 the stock rating was maintained by Jefferies with “Buy”. The firm has “Buy” rating by Nomura given on Thursday, May 12. The firm earned “Overweight” rating on Thursday, November 10 by Morgan Stanley. The stock of NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) earned “Hold” rating by Jefferies on Monday, December 18. Bernstein maintained it with “Sell” rating and $285.0 target in Tuesday, February 27 report. The firm has “Hold” rating by Jefferies given on Tuesday, October 3. The firm has “Outperform” rating by CLSA given on Monday, October 3. The firm has “Overweight” rating by JP Morgan given on Thursday, February 25. Credit Suisse maintained the stock with “Outperform” rating in Monday, September 21 report. The company was maintained on Monday, July 17 by Jefferies. 
First Foundation Advisors, which manages about $3.20 billion and $1.76 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Blackrock Ltd Duration (NYSE:BLW) by 56,632 shares to 330,758 shares, valued at $5.33M in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Qualcomm Inc (NASDAQ:QCOM) by 37,489 shares in the quarter, for a total of 298,361 shares, and has risen its stake in Chevron Corp (NYSE:CVX). 
Analysts await NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) to report earnings on May, 9. They expect $3.47 earnings per share, down 19.11% or $0.82 from last year’s $4.29 per share. NTES’s profit will be $455.47 million for 20.80 P/E if the $3.47 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.49 actual earnings per share reported by NetEase, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 132.89% EPS growth.
